sentences.text:
======================================================
 Baiju Mistree Son Of Mita Mistree Resident Of Village- Bahodi Bigha, Ps
 Karai, Parsurai, Dist- Nalanda ... Petitioner
 Versus
 The State of Bihar ... Opposite Part
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Amarendra Kumar Mishra, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Nirmal Kumar Sinha, Addl Public Pro
 ====================================================

==
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 3 16-04-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.
2. The petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 420, 467, 468 471 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per the prosecution case, on the basis of forged documents, petitioner had purchased SIM and was using it in the mobile phone.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case on the basis of suspicion.
He is using the said SIM card since last 20 years.
There is no allegation that he has committed any crime or the SIM used by the petitioner has ever been used in commission of the crime.
5. Considering the aforesaid facts of the case, prayer for bail of the petitioner is allowed.

In the event of arrest/surrender within six weeks from today, let the petitioner, Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.10066 of 2024(3) dt.16-04-2024 mentioned above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate III, Hilsa, Nalanda in Karai Pursarai (Nalanda) Police Station Case No. 27 of 2022, subject to the conditions laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
